Name: Geese Unification Project - Golden and Stellar Goose Eggs for every geese
Author: zombifier
Description:
Does what it says on the tin:
[list]
[*]Allows the geese from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45160]Mizu's Goose[/url] to also drop the golden eggs from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].[/*]
[*]Allows the geese from Stardew Valley Expanded and Mizu's Goose to also drop stellar goose eggs after the secret from VMV is unlocked. The stellar goose egg will hatch into VMV's stellar goose as usual.[/*]
[/list]
Note that the three goose types, and their produce, are still different from each other + only Mizu and VMV's geese will drop their Down items! If you want to switch between the item variants, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21363]Toggle Artisan Goods[/url]. This mod just makes the three goose type have (mostly) feature parity with each other and reduce the friction of keeping track of which goose produces what for perfection.

To install, extract into the Mods folder as usual. Some combination of Stardew Valley Expanded, VMV or Mizu's Goose is required.
